commands.collection:
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import datetime
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import time

app=Path('/vercel/evaluation/rea')
output=Path('/vercel/output')
accepted=json.loads((output/'controller-accepted-final.json').read_text())
assert accepted['summary']=={'PASS':20,'FAIL':0,'NOT_TESTED':8},accepted['summary']
assert len(accepted['cases'])==28
assert (output/'controller-acceptance.exit').read_text().strip()=='0'
assert (output/'controller-negative-gate.exit').read_text().strip()=='1'
negative=json.loads((output/'controller-negative-gate.json').read_text())
negative_state=Path(negative['statePath'])
assert (negative_state/'launch-counter').read_text()=='0'

def processes():
    found=[]
    for path in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not path.name.isdecimal():continue
        try:
            args=(path/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
            if len(args)>1 and args[1].decode(errors='replace') in [str(app/'experiments/execution-controller/controller.py'),str(app/'experiments/execution-controller/worker.py')]:
                found.append(int(path.name))
        except (OSError,ValueError):pass
    return found

deadline=time.monotonic()+35
while processes() and time.monotonic()<deadline:time.sleep(0.2)
remaining=processes()
assert not remaining,remaining
private=[]
root=Path('/var/lib/rea-controller')
for state in sorted(root.glob('test-*')):
    with sqlite3.connect(f'file:{state}/state.db?mode=ro',uri=True) as db:
        counts={table:db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM '+table).fetchone()[0] for table in ['requests','decisions','audit']}
    runs=list((state/'runs').iterdir())
    private.append({'state':str(state),'rowsAfterExpiry':counts,'rawRunHandles':len(runs)})
    assert all(v==0 for v in counts.values()),(str(state),counts)
    assert not runs,(str(state),runs)
groups=[str(p) for p in Path('/sys/fs/cgroup').glob('rea-eval-*')]
assert not groups,groups
registry_hash=hashlib.sha256((root/'registry.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
debug=output/'controller-private-debug.log'
debug_existed=debug.exists()
debug.unlink(missing_ok=True)
shutil.rmtree(root)
Path('/run/rea-controller.sock').unlink(missing_ok=True)
Path('/run/rea-evaluation-vm').unlink(missing_ok=True)
assert not root.exists() and not debug.exists()

paths=sorted(p for p in (app/'experiments/execution-controller').iterdir() if p.is_file())
source={str(p.relative_to(app)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
for name in ['package.json','package-lock.json','LICENSE']:
    source[name]=hashlib.sha256((app/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
core_diff=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','--','src','tests','.github','package.json','package-lock.json','LICENSE'],cwd=app,text=True)
assert core_diff==''
trial_summaries=[]
for path in sorted(output.glob('controller-smoke-trial-*.json')):
    r=json.loads(path.read_text())
    trial_summaries.append({'name':path.name,'summary':r['summary'],
        'errors':[{'id':c['id'],'errorType':c.get('errorType'),'diagnostic':c.get('diagnostic')} for c in r['cases'] if c['status']=='FAIL']})
metrics={name:Path('/sys/fs/cgroup',name).read_text() for name in ['memory.max','memory.peak','memory.events','pids.max','pids.peak','cpu.stat']}
record={'timestamp':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'baseline':accepted['baseline'],'caseResults':accepted,
    'sourceSha256':source,'registrySha256':registry_hash,
    'checks':{'buildExit':(output/'build.exit').read_text().strip(),
              'pythonCompile':'PASS (three Python source files, before acceptance)',
              'formatLog':(output/'controller-format-check.log').read_text(),
              'lintLog':(output/'controller-lint.log').read_text(),
              'acceptanceExit':0,'negativeDriverGate':{'expectedExit':1,'actualExit':1,'launches':0,
                  'reason':'Operator-provisioned registry with disallowed HOME; FAIL record must produce nonzero exit.'}},
    'acceptanceLog':(output/'controller-acceptance-final.log').read_text(),
    'acceptanceTiming':{'realSeconds':81.75,'userSeconds':33.20,'sysSeconds':5.52,
        'source':'bash time output of final acceptance command; includes its child workload, not an equivalent before/after benchmark'},
    'parentBuildLog':(output/'build.log').read_text(),
    'disposal':{'controllerWorkerJanitorProcesses':remaining,'ownedCgroups':groups,
        'privateStoresBeforeRemoval':private,'privateRootRemoved':not root.exists(),
        'rawDiagnosticCopyWasPresent':debug_existed,'rawDiagnosticCopyRemoved':not debug.exists(),
        'socketRemoved':not Path('/run/rea-controller.sock').exists(),
        'scope':'Controlled logical copies and worker lifetime only. No physical erasure or unknown provider-backup proof.'},
    'outerCgroupMetrics':metrics,'developmentSmokes':trial_summaries,
    'verdict':{'prototype':'PARTIAL','REA_1_1':'PARTIAL','productionAndUnrestrictedAgents':'NO_GO',
        'realCredentials':'NOT_COLLECTED','humanReview':'NOT_ATTESTED','platformIntegration':False,
        'mainChanged':False,'nativeProviders':'NOT_TESTED','fullSCA':'NOT_TESTED'},
}
raw=json.dumps(record,indent=2).encode()
(output/'controller-export.json').write_bytes(raw)
compressed=gzip.compress(raw)
(output/'controller-export.gz').write_bytes(compressed)
b64=base64.b64encode(compressed).decode()
(output/'controller-export.b64').write_text(b64)
print(json.dumps({'bytes':len(raw),'gzipSha256':hashlib.sha256(compressed).hexdigest(),'base64Characters':len(b64),'chunks':(len(b64)+1799)//1800,'summary':accepted['summary'],'privateStoresCleared':len(private),'processes':remaining,'cgroups':groups},indent=2))

sourceDerivedResiduals.observation: Janitor startup has no readiness acknowledgement before the controller exposes its socket. Death before the janitor opens the parent pidfd was not tested. Live-run SIGKILL was tested successfully.
sourceDerivedResiduals.next: Add startup acknowledgement and early-death/failure acceptance.

sourceDerivedResiduals.observation: Threaded Unix protocol does not implement per-client connection/rate limits or a read deadline. Fixed synthetic tests do not certify hostile-client availability.

driverEvidenceKindQualification: The driver uses a generic evidenceKind label. It is not proof of full execution: EA-23 and EA-28 only record unimplemented/pending status; other NOT_TESTED cases retain partial observations. Use status, remaining and scopeQualification together.
